github.GITHUB_WORKFLOW: California Housing SGDM full grid and long horizon

spectral.method: Unmodified WeightWatcher 0.7.7 analyze per unique eligible matrix; powerlaw 2.0.0; ordinary fitted alpha; weights sqrt(num_pl_spikes)/(D+0.02); no matrix-size factor. Minimum matrix dimension 64 admits one 784x784 hidden matrix, so the model average equals that fit and layer dispersion is unavailable. Diagnostic eigenvalues are sorted SVD(W.float64)^2 without normalization.

protocol: constant LR; no patience stopping; fixed declared budget; test never selects settings or checkpoints
sampling: one torch.randperm per epoch, including final partial minibatch
selection_rule: Strict minimum full validation RMSE at the window start, each complete epoch, and final declared budget; ties retain earlier checkpoint
